import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from model_runtime.salvage_agent_workspace import (
    salvage,
)


def git(cwd: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "-c",
            "core.autocrlf=false",
            *args,
        ],
        cwd=str(cwd),
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


class SalvageAgentWorkspaceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_strict_salvage_ignores_dirty_unexpected_file(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base = Path(tmp)
            remote = base / "remote.git"
            workspaces = base / "workspaces"
            workspaces.mkdir()
            repo = workspaces / "job-workspace"

            git(
                base,
                "init",
                "--bare",
                str(remote),
            )
            git(
                base,
                "clone",
                str(remote),
                str(repo),
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "config",
                "user.name",
                "Test",
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "config",
                "user.email",
                "test@example.invalid",
            )

            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "base\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.bat").write_bytes(
                b"base\r\n"
            )
            git(repo, "add", "-A")
            git(repo, "commit", "-m", "base")
            git(
                repo,
                "push",
                "-u",
                "origin",
                "HEAD:main",
            )

            job_id = (
                "routing-v02-main-test-i0-123"
            )
            branch = (
                f"ai/job-{job_id}-main-coder"
            )
            git(
                repo,
                "checkout",
                "-b",
                branch,
            )

            (repo / "wanted.txt").write_text(
                "wanted change\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (repo / "noise.bat").write_bytes(
                b"base\n"
            )

            result = salvage(
                job_id,
                workspace_root=workspaces,
                expected_origin=str(remote),
                handoff={
                    "strict_target_paths": True,
                    "target_paths": [
                        "wanted.txt"
                    ],
                },
            )

            self.assertTrue(
                result["salvaged"]
            )
            self.assertIn(
                "noise.bat",
                result[
                    "restored_unexpected"
                ],
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                result["branch"],
                branch,
            )

            diff = git(
                repo,
                "diff",
                "--name-only",
                "main...HEAD",
            ).splitlines()
            self.assertEqual(
                diff,
                ["wanted.txt"],
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
